title: Puppy holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 40 Q66 55 60 68' stroke='#c8b8ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='28' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff5c8a'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='23' rx='4' ry='5.5' fill='#ff9ab8'/>
  <path d='M62 43 L58.5 47 L65.5 47 Z' fill='#d63e6c'/>
  <!-- puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='72' rx='17' ry='13' fill='#e8a45c'/>
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='76' rx='10' ry='8' fill='#f7c98e'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='80' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e8a45c'/>
  <rect x='46' y='80' width='6' height='11' rx='3' fill='#e8a45c'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='91' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#f7c98e'/>
  <ellipse cx='49' cy='91' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#f7c98e'/>
  <!-- arm holding string -->
  <rect x='52' y='64' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e8a45c' transform='rotate(-18 55 70)'/>
  <!-- puppy head -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='50' r='17' fill='#e8a45c'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='44' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#b5703a' transform='rotate(18 24 44)'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='44' rx='6' ry='10' fill='#b5703a' transform='rotate(-18 56 44)'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='58' rx='10' ry='7.5' fill='#f7c98e'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='47' r='3' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='47' r='3' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#ffe8c8'/>
  <circle cx='48' cy='46' r='1.1' fill='#ffe8c8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='55' rx='3.4' ry='2.6' fill='#3a2418'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M40 58 Q37 62 34 59' stroke='#3a2418' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 58 Q43 62 46 59' stroke='#3a2418' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='62.5' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#ff6f91'/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d='M58 68 Q68 62 66 54' stroke='#e8a45c' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
